# Amica Digital Services

> Amica Digital Services Ltd is a UK digital growth and AI automation agency based at 378 Claremont Road, Manchester, M14 7WB (company number 17020927), founded by Muhammad Shahzad (Shaz) Chughtai. It builds websites, SEO, social media, lead generation, GoHighLevel CRM, AI chatbots, AI voice agents (AI receptionists) and workflow automation for UK businesses, with a specialism in care agencies and recruitment agencies.

Automation is designed to support each client's team, not replace it: staff can see and step into every conversation.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Amica Digital Services Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 17020927.
- Founder: Muhammad Shahzad Chughtai, known as Shaz. More than 15 years of hands-on experience in business development, recruitment, staffing, customer service and operational management.
- Plans: Foundation £199/month, Growth £490/month, Pro £990/month. Rolling 30-day plans have a one-off setup fee (Foundation £200, Growth £990, Pro £1,950), waived on longer agreements (6 months for Foundation, 12 months for Growth and Pro). Not VAT registered.
- Care and Recruitment Agency Automation Package: £490/month (12 months, no setup fee) or £990 setup + £490/month rolling.
- AI voice agents (AI receptionists), custom websites, software and advertising campaigns are quoted individually.
- Typical implementation: four to six weeks.
- Main platform: GoHighLevel, with APIs and other platforms where they suit the job.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00 UK time. Phone +44 7446 981768. Email shaz@amicadigitalservices.com.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/112604923
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/922791870926750
